concerns.text: T008's smoke test 're-runs the thin pipeline and asserts all metric values in data/results/metrics_raw.csv match a stored reference' — but the thin pipeline (T003) only writes per_sample_errors.csv and pipeline_run.json; metrics_raw.csv is produced by T005 from the FULL pipeline. The smoke test consumes an artifact its re-run does not produce, so either the thin run must also emit metrics (a missing producer step in T003), or the smoke test must regenerate metrics from the thin per-sample output before comparing. As ordered, T008's verification cannot pass.
